Title: Remote Study Participants - AI & Research (Monterrey)
Description: About Prolific Prolific is not just another player in the AI space – we are building the biggest pool of quality human data in the world. Over 35,000 AI developers, researchers, and organizations use Prolific to gather data from paid study participants with a wide variety of experiences, knowledge, and skills. The role We are looking for Study Participants from all professional backgrounds across Mexico to take part in academic and applied research studies for global businesses and educational faculties. Whether you are just starting your career or are a seasoned expert, your perspective is valuable. We are actively seeking a diverse range of educational backgrounds, including: No High School Diploma / High School Graduates Trade School & Vocational Professionals (MBO) Undergraduate & Master's Degree Holders (HBO/WO) PhD Candidates & Doctoral Researchers If you have the necessary experience, we'll send you a quick 10- to 15-minute screening to assess your suitability. If successful, you'll be invited to join Prolific as a participant, where you'll get paid to contribute to a wide range of projects. While many tasks are short, you should be prepared for studies that require up to one hour of uninterrupted work. What you'll bring As a participant, you will contribute to high-quality research outcomes by responding thoughtfully to various tasks, including: AI Training & Evaluation: helping refine Large Language Models by ranking responses or providing creative prompts. Behavioral Experiments: participating in decision-making tasks and cognitive games. User Research: providing feedback on new software, apps, or product concepts. Academic Studies: assisting university researchers in fields like psychology, economics, and sociology. Interviews: engaging in one-on-one deep dives regarding your professional expertise or lived experience. Surveys & Questionnaires: sharing your opinions on current events, consumer habits, or workplace culture. What you'll be doing in the role Diverse Perspective: a track record of relevant experience, knowledge, or lived context (from entry-level roles to executive or academic positions). Attention to Detail: the ability to remain focused and provide high-quality data for the duration of a study. Technical Setup: a reliable, fast internet connection and access to a desktop or laptop computer. Financial Readiness: a PayPal account to receive payments and a willingness to self-declare earnings as a self-employed participant. Why Prolific is a great platform to join as a Participant Joining our platform as a Prolific participant will give you the chance to influence the AI models of the future using professional legal expertise. Once you pass our assessment, you can join Prolific in just 15 minutes, and start enjoying competitive pay rates, flexible hours, and the ability to work from home. We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioural data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems. We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models, but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviours into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation – one that reflects the breadth and the best of humanity. Prolific's Candidate Privacy Notice explains what personal information Prolific may process, where Prolific may process your personal information, its purposes for processing your personal information, and the rights you can exercise over Prolific use of your personal personal information.

Title: ECM Developer
Description: Req ID: 346193 NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now. We are currently seeking a ECM Developer to join our team in Monterrey, Nuevo León (MX-NLE), Mexico (MX). Overview The ECM Developer is a highly skilled software engineer supporting an ECM platform built on IBM FileNet P8 and Business Automation Workflow (BAW 24.x). A migration to IBM Cloud Pak for Business Automation (CP4BA) on Red Hat OpenShift 4.x on AWS (ROSA) is planned. This role involves designing and implementing cloud-native ECM solutions and collaborating with ECM Analysts and Architects to deliver secure, scalable, and high-performing applications. Responsibilities Design, develop, and maintain complex Java applications, including mission-critical service layers for the ECM platform. Translate business requirements into innovative, secure, and scalable technical solutions. Ensure solutions are vulnerability-free, follow modern IT standards, and leverage emerging technologies. Maintain a production-first mindset focused on uptime, scalability, and rapid issue resolution. Collaborate with internal business units and stakeholders to ensure successful project delivery. Provide technical demos and presentations to team members and business partners. Foster a collaborative and productive team environment. Qualifications Knowledge Expert-level experience with IBM FileNet P8 APIs (Content Engine, Process Engine). Deep expertise in ICN 3.x+ and ICM 5.x customization using the Dojo framework. Strong understanding of RESTful API development, integration patterns, and OpenAPI Specification (OAS 3.x). Proven experience designing and deploying BAW 24.x solutions. Strong experience with CI/CD pipelines, Git repositories, and automated build/deploy tools (e.g., Jenkins, Azure DevOps). Familiarity with static code analysis tools such as Checkmarx, SonarQube, or equivalent for secure coding practices. Experience with Kubernetes-based platforms (OpenShift 4.x), RHEL, and ROSA. Cloud proficiency (IBM Cloud, AWS, Azure); certifications preferred. Understanding API Gateway technologies such as Azure API Management (APIM) and identity management platforms like Okta IAM. Bonus knowledge: Gen AI (WatsonX.ai), IBM Datacap, Kofax Capture. Skills ICN Customization: Plugin development including External Data Services (EDS), Feature and Action Plugins, Context Menu Customization, and custom scheduled task development using the ICN Task Manager framework and APIs. Java/J2EE: Spring Boot, JPA, Hibernate, Microservices. Web Technologies: Dojo, NodeJS, AngularJS, ReactJS, HTML, JavaScript, AJAX, jQuery. ECM Suite: FileNet P8, ICN 3.x+, ICM 5.x, BAW 24.x, IER, ICC, FDM, Sweep Framework. ECM Migration: SharePoint, Domino, FileNet P8 to CP4BA. Security & Governance: Role-based access, retention policies, security proxies, change preprocessors. App Servers: IBM WebSphere (ND, Liberty, Open Liberty), WebLogic, Tomcat. Reporting & Monitoring: Sweep jobs, stored procedures, Control-M, Splunk. DevOps Tools: AzDO, GitHub, Jenkins, Docker, Kubernetes, Ansible, Terraform. Databases: Oracle, PostgreSQL. Bonus Skills: Python, AWS services (EC2, S3, Lambda, IAM, VPC, ECS, CloudWatch, API Gateway). EDUCATION Bachelor's degree in computer science or related field, or equivalent work experience. Experience Minimum 5 years as an ECM Developer. 5+ years developing enterprise-grade ECM solutions using IBM FileNet and Java/J2EE. Proven experience customizing, configuring, and maintaining IBM FileNet-based platforms. WORKING CONDITIONS This remote contractor role follows a fixed schedule aligned to U.S. business hours. Candidates must be available during assigned times for collaboration, delivery, and support. Extended hours may occasionally be required based on project needs. Title: Remote Data Quality Assurance Engineer
Description: Req ID: 367237 NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now. We are currently seeking a Remote Data Quality Assurance Engineer to join our team in Monterrey, Nuevo León (MX-NLE), Mexico (MX). We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Data Quality Assurance Engineer to lead data validation and data quality assurance for a large-scale cloud modernization initiative. In this senior technical leadership role, you will ensure the delivery of reliable, high-quality data solutions across enterprise systems by driving best practices in data quality, ETL processes, and data standardization. You will develop and implement comprehensive testing strategies for data migration, integration, and transformation, while partnering with cross-functional teams to enable automated data quality assurance and operational excellence. This position offers the opportunity to shape trusted, cloud-based data solutions that power analytics, AI/ML, and digital innovation across the organization at a global scale. Job Duties Leadership & Strategy Lead QA planning, strategy, and execution for data migration projects with multiple concurrent releases. Provide guidance and mentorship to the DQA team (onshore, offshore, nearshore) to ensure timely, accurate test completion and defect resolution. Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement across teams. Serve as the primary escalation point for Data Quality Assurance (DQA) and User Acceptance Testing (UAT). Stay current with emerging technologies and best practices in test strategies, automation, and quality engineering. Testing & Automation Design and implement scalable test automation frameworks for validating data pipelines and transformations. Develop and maintain automated test scripts for ingestion, transformation, and output validation to ensure comprehensive coverage. Support development teams in adopting shift-left testing practices to improve quality early in the lifecycle. Drive quality innovation through new technologies, testing tools, and automation solutions. Compliance & Governance Ensure adherence to data quality dimensions, industry best practices, SOX compliance, and security policies to maintain data integrity and confidentiality. Maintain detailed audit trails and documentation to support internal and external reviews. Drive process compliance and governance through accurate reporting and documentation. Reporting & Communication Deliver clear, actionable reporting on test execution, coverage, and defect trends to inform leadership decisions. Provide go/no-go recommendations based on test results and risk assessments. Promote technical excellence and knowledge sharing across teams. Collaborate in daily stand-up meetings. What makes you a dream candidate? Knowledge Champions a data quality-first mindset with exceptional attention to detail and accuracy. Deep expertise in data profiling, validation, standardization, and cleansing to ensure trusted data assets. Experience in large-scale data migrations, including on-premises to cloud transitions, Medallion architecture, data warehousing, lakehouse, and delta frameworks. Proficient in Python and Unix/Linux scripting. Solid understanding of project management, agile, and SDLC principles. Proven ability to design and implement robust data quality test cases, constraints and triggers with a strong emphasis on anomaly detection and prevention (left shift). Skills Exceptional communication skills with the ability to translate technical concepts into business value while fostering stakeholder trust and collaboration. Strong organizational and time management capabilities, ensuring effective prioritization and timely delivery. Proven track record of driving process improvements and implementing automation techniques to enhance efficiency and quality. Ability to apply critical thinking and creativity to solve complex problems, make informed decisions independently, and thrive in a fast-paced environment. Qualifications & Technical Skills ETL, Informatica & DataBricks experience. Data migration experience is a plus. Bachelor’s Degree in related field or equivalent experience required. 4+ years of hands-on experience in data quality or data governance role with a focus on test data management, including at least 2 years in a lead or senior QA role. 5+ years of advanced experience querying complex data structures and performing root-cause analysis. Advanced knowledge of ETL process and techniques. Title: Data & Automation Analyst (BI + IA)
Description: Company Description Papalote Museo del Niño Monterrey is part of the Papalote network in Mexico, recognized for over 30 years as a leader in interactive museums and learning experiences through play. Established in 2018, the museum has become one of the most prominent educational and cultural spaces in northern Mexico, impacting thousands of families, students, and teachers annually. Operated as a non-profit organization, it focuses on creating long-term educational, social, and environmental impact with a child-centered approach to learning through its “Touch, Play, and Learn” model. The museum actively fosters STEAM education, sustainability, and critical 21st-century skills through diverse programs, including school visits, immersive experiences, and initiatives like Papalote para Todos, promoting inclusivity and equity in education. As the museum enters a new phase with projects like Papalote al Futuro, it aims to extend its reach, integrate new technologies, and scale its impact across the region. Role Description This is a full-time on-site role based in Monterrey, NLE, for a Data & Automation Analyst (BI + IA). Responsibilities include developing and managing business intelligence tools, analyzing data to provide actionable insights, ensuring data accuracy through thorough testing, and driving process automation. The analyst will collaborate with different teams to identify improvement opportunities and implement solutions that enhance operational efficiency and decision-making. The ideal candidate will also contribute to the integration and optimization of innovative technologies to support the organization’s strategic initiatives. Qualifications Strong Analytical Skills to interpret complex data, identify trends, and derive actionable insights. Excellent Communication skills to present findings clearly and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams. Experience in Testing to ensure data accuracy and system reliability. Proficiency in Process Automation and Automation tools to improve operational efficiency. Additional qualifications such as experience with business intelligence platforms, proficiency in programming languages like Python or SQL, and familiarity with AI/ML technologies are a plus. Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field preferred. Ability to work proactively in a team-oriented and mission-driven environment.
